what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Afghanistan in Iraq: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 10277 Afghan asylum seekers in Iraq, 3.8% of all asylum seekers from Afghanistan.
Refugees from Afghanistan, a separate group, live mostly in Pakistan and Iran, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 2007 to 2025, at war level in most of them, with the Taleban, the NRF and the High Council of Afghanistan Islamic Emirate among the parties.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Afghanistan from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2012 at 33 asylum seekers.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2025, when the figure is at its highest.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Iraq.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Iraq only.
